data.content: The OSCE in Kosovo entrusted us with the creation of two impactful videos for the Ministry of Internal Affairs, aimed at raising awareness about the harsh realities of human trafficking. Each screenplay was crafted with thoughtful precision, drawing from real-life situations that resonate deeply within Kosovo's own landscape, ensuring an authentic and meaningful portrayal.

The first video addresses the issue of online grooming and blackmail, a shadow that looms especially over teenage girls, who are often more vulnerable to manipulation. This story brings to light the profound challenges many young girls face in navigating the dangers of the digital world.

The second video unravels the harsh reality of fake job profiles that lure young women with promises of employment in the EU, only to entrap them in the brutal world of human trafficking. It also shines a light on the plight of young men, deceived by fraudulent agencies, who invest their savings in the hope of securing work in Europe, only to find themselves abandoned on foreign streets, penniless and lost.

data.text: The Title is Not the News (2021)

data.content: Awareness campaign created for OSCE in Kosovo with the aim of informing citizens about misinformation that comes from incomplete information, and how to protect from fake news.

A webpage created especially for the quiz, with a double aim, self assessing and informing citizens on how to identify fake news. The winners received goods with attractive designs from the campaign’s theme.
Check out the website here.
